scenario.title: Battle of Konitsa
intro.text:
BATTLE OF KONITSA - 25 DEC 1947

South of Konitsa, Epirus

The communist rebels have attacked the city Konitsa on the Greek-Albanian border! The garrison defended the town stubbornly and until now was able to fend off all attacks. Advance on Konitsa and expel the rebels!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE In this mission the AI has the first turn!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-17-0-briliant.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.reaction-17-0-briliant.text: Athens and Piraeus were secured before the urban front could harden further. The government survives, British troops dominate the settlement, and Greek prisoners fill Greek compounds.
line.reaction-17-1-victory-tactical.text: The government has recovered the capital, but the battle ended through exhaustion and British weight as much as consent. Varkiza will now ask paper to contain what the streets could not.
line.callback-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-0.text: Scobie has left Greece. His unified command ended the Athens battle and left us the institutions built under it. We cannot send those home with him.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: A nurse from the Athens corridor recognised our unit badge in Konitsa. She thanked us, then asked where the men taken from her street had gone. I could answer only the first half.
line.callback-2.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.callback-2.text: The Rimini engineers remained together. Their foreign battle honour followed them into Greek streets where honour offered less protection.
line.callback-3.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-3.text: Rimini's engineers were distributed through the brigade. Their experience remained military even when the government tried to turn the victory into a factional credential.
line.scene-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-0.text: Konitsa has built barricades before the engineers arrived. If the town falls, the DSE will announce a capital before our communiqué admits there was a battle.
line.scene-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-1.text: The gendarmerie lieutenant asking us for ammunition wore a Security Battalion badge in 1944. Headquarters calls that experience. The baker calls him by the name he used then.
line.scene-2.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-2.text: He commands no search and no evacuation. Put an army officer over him and write the order before he receives a cartridge.
line.scene-3.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-3.text: The baker on the north street has six soldiers in his cellar and his family in the shop. He asked which part of the building the army intends to save.
line.scene-4.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-4.text: If we abandon the streets, we may abandon the town. If we fill them with guns, the baker gets his answer.
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: Anchor the defence inside Konitsa, or hold the villages and evacuation roads with mobile groups?
line.decision.choice.fortify-konitsa.tex: Concentrate infantry and artillery inside Konitsa.
line.decision.choice.fortify-konitsa.hin: Give infantry and artillery 15 experience and restore the core to at least nine strength with full ammunition.
line.decision.choice.build-the-outer-bel: Use mobile groups to hold the villages and evacuation roads outside the town.
Spend 50 prestige, give reconnaissance 20 experience, and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: Then mark fallback streets before the first house disappears under sandbags. The outer companies need a route into town that does not end at somebody's kitchen.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-a-1.text: Agreed. Three urban sectors, one reserve, batteries tied to withdrawal routes. Konitsa holds from the inside.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-b-0.text: A mobile belt gives the DSE a chance to get between us and the town. I want no patrol out of wireless range.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: They will carry guides and evacuation parties. We hold the approaches, move families off the gun roads, and keep one company where the town can see it.
